properties.description: Bronze incremental load. The 'incremental' part for OLTP retail data is fully driven by the SQL Mirror (continuous CDC) -- so this pipeline only needs to refresh the bronze sources that are NOT mirrored. Today that means the daily weather pull. Synthetic-activity generation runs as the first step of pl_incremental_load (not part of bronze) and self-polls the mirror before returning.

activities.name: Weather catchup
activities.description: Runs pl_bronze_weather_ingest. The ingest_weather notebook merges on (date, store_id) so re-running picks up only new days since the last run.
